result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to an M&A successor, but it does not reach the preferred termination position. Allowing revocation upon any expiry or termination of the Agreement could permit termination for convenience or reasons other than Customer’s uncured material breach. It also does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable. Further, the unchanged downstream language stating that the licence “shall be revoked” is not conformed to the new restriction and references section 3 rather than section 2, creating ambiguity. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the clause’s unrelated commercial scope.
